label: Usability Audit
description: Evaluate an existing interface against usability heuristics, accessibility standards, and UX best practices. Produces prioritised findings with severity ratings.

modelTier.notes: Sonnet for standard audits. Opus for complex enterprise systems with multiple user types.

guidedInputs.label: Product / Interface Description
guidedInputs.description: Describe the product or interface to be audited. Include URL if accessible, or upload screenshots.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Mobile banking app (iOS) — account overview, transfer, and payment flows. URL: app.bank.com

guidedInputs.label: Key User Tasks to Evaluate
guidedInputs.description: Which user journeys or tasks should the audit focus on?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 1. Log in and check balance. 2. Send money to a new recipient. 3. Set up a standing order.

guidedInputs.label: Target User Profile
guidedInputs.description: Who are the users? Their tech literacy, age range, accessibility needs, context of use.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Adults 45-75, moderate tech literacy, may use screen magnification, mobile-first

guidedInputs.label: Audit Scope
guidedInputs.description: Which frameworks should the audit apply?
